title: The Bridge of Light
text: A bridge of coloured light arches over a gulf with no bottom, bright as a rainbow and thin as a blade. It hums when the wind touches it. It holds only the brave, the stories say. The stories do not say what becomes of the rest.

options.label: Cross boldly, together, and trust the stories to hold.

outcomes.text: It holds, humming beneath your feet. You feel braver for having trusted it.
It holds most of you, though not all of you, and not all the way.

options.label: The bravest goes first and calls back, so the others know it holds.

outcomes.text: It holds firm under them and under everyone after, ringing like struck glass.

options.label: Find another way. You have no wish to learn what becomes of the rest.

outcomes.text: The other way is long and dull. Behind you, the rainbow glimmers mockingly.
